headline: Ministry of Commerce Unveils New 'Middleman Export' Subsidy to Help Global Powers Launder Their Tariff Liabilities
body:
The Union Ministry of Commerce today announced the launch of the 'Global Tariff Optimization Scheme,' a flagship initiative designed to formalize the role of domestic traders in assisting foreign powers with complex bookkeeping requirements. The move comes in response to international reports suggesting that local exporters have been acting as a vital customs-evasion concierge for large economies struggling with pesky cross-border levies.

“We are simply providing a value-added service,” said an Undersecretary for Indirect Logistics, speaking on condition of anonymity while shredding a stack of shipping invoices. “If a superpower finds itself burdened by high tariffs, it is only neighborly for our local SMEs to re-label their goods with a ‘Made in Somewhere-Else’ sticker. It’s not a scam; it’s a sophisticated global supply-chain arbitrage.”

To facilitate this, the government plans to set up 'Neutralization Parks' at major ports, where shipping containers can spend twenty minutes getting their country-of-origin tags swapped by unionized workers. Critics who called the practice a 'great scam' were dismissed by officials as being 'mathematically challenged' regarding the nuances of international trade velocity.

Exporters looking to join the scheme are encouraged to register their phantom warehouses online. The Ministry assured participants that as long as the paperwork is sufficiently confusing, no international investigator will ever bother to find the actual origin of a solar panel or a ball-bearing.
caption: India launches a new 'Logistics Optimization' scheme for global partners. Efficiency is key! #Trade #GlobalEconomy #India #Export (satire)
